author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
Nailing siding correctly matters if you want the material to expand and contract without buckling or getting damaged. In this video, I’ll show you the right way to nail Gentek ALIGN Composite Cladding, including how deep to drive the galvanized roofing nails, why you should leave about a 1/32-inch gap, and the common overdriving mistake to avoid.

You can watch the full video 👉🏼https://youtu.be/qhsfv9os8EU
